purpose: Validated PA-2 source manifest; not importable Dataverse XML. Replace declarations with platform-generated export artifacts before packing.

authorization.trustedActorSource: Power Apps V2 authenticated runtime context only; never request payload fields
authorization.rule: Require exactly one active platform user, exactly one active banker, active deal, and assigned banker equality. No inferred admin override.

sharePointSemantics.collisionBehavior: Exact-name lookup before create; reject cross-deal objects; never overwrite or auto-rename.
sharePointSemantics.readback: Require exact parent, type, IDs, size for files, ETag, and webUrl before COMPLETED.
sharePointSemantics.partialFailure: Set fileMayExist and reconciliationRequired after possible create with failed readback; reconcile before retry.
